focus: The Desk is current through August 23 with article-specific AI editorial art whose masthead and punchline are composed in protected zones for clear desktop and mobile reading. Every article also shows estimated read time plus a privacy-safe Reader views status; real values remain hidden until five browser pageloads qualify.
nextStep: Let real reader traffic accumulate without lowering the five-page privacy threshold, while giving each future Desk edition its own deterministic visual-integrity receipt and recent-art diversity check.
